name: quinled-dig-next-2-16.0.1
description: QuinLED's published WLED 16.0.1 build for the Dig-Next-2, as released 2026-10-27 (with PowerManager)
notes: web_build_time: WLED's UI build stamps WEB_BUILD_TIME (tools/cdata.js). QuinLED's value was read from a device's HTTP ETag and appears exactly once in the reference image.
The PowerManager pin is v1.3.0, the newest tag before the reference was built; the override fetches the default branch unpinned.
The reference was built on Windows: its newlib strings carry HOST-x86_64-w64-mingw32.
